facade.identity: Qualified GStreamer accepted-native-token to source-PTS registry reused unchanged. No FIFO/POC guess, raw-token repair or runtime pixel-hash matching.
facade.stock_Kodi_pause: Kodi controls input dispatch. Its speed notification leaves already queued codec packets admissible. Explicit private pause_input is separate; facade pause counters of zero in these stock Kodi tests are expected.
facade.buffer_path: Existing RX->ownedGst->checkedKodi-ownedYUY2 rows, two host copies. No added copy, zero-copy, EXPBUF/EGL or no-mapping claim.
facade.completion: Finite parent demux EOF plus delivery of all video packets permits exactly one terminal EOS. Returned pictures must equal accepted queue census; temporary DRAIN is not finite EOF.
facade.count_scope: Queue acceptance and output to Kodi, not raw DIL call counts, render submissions or scanout.
